item.title: Oil & Gas CNC Machining | B&R Productions
item.description: Oil & Gas CNC machining in New Waverly, TX. API 6A wellhead, frac pump, downhole, wireline in Inconel, Super Duplex 2507, 17-4 PH. Emergency rig-down capable.

item.title: Industrial CNC Machining | B&R Productions
item.description: Industrial CNC machining in New Waverly, TX. Automation, material handling, power generation, and MRO components. Full alloy range from 4140 through Inconel.

item.title: Military & Defense CNC Machining | B&R Productions
item.description: Military & defense CNC machining in New Waverly, TX. Defense-adjacent hardware, ground vehicles, tactical components, and legacy sustainment parts. Non-ITAR work; full material traceability.

item.title: Aerospace CNC Machining | B&R Productions
item.description: Aerospace CNC machining in New Waverly, TX. Titanium Ti-6Al-4V, Inconel 718, Aluminum 7075, 15-5 PH. Structural, engine, UAV, and space-system components.

item.title: CNC Turning | B&R Productions
item.description: CNC turning services in New Waverly, TX. 7 CNC lathes (Hwacheon, Samsung) covering small precision to large heavy-roughing envelopes. Inconel, Super Duplex, 17-4 PH.

item.title: CNC Milling | B&R Productions
item.description: CNC milling in New Waverly, TX. Fadal VMC 4020 + YCM TV-188 B vertical machining centers for aerospace, oilfield, defense prismatic parts in exotic alloys.

item.title: Manual Machining | B&R Productions
item.description: Manual machining in New Waverly, TX. Kingston manual lathes for one-offs, prototypes, sustainment, reverse-engineered oilfield parts, quick-turn repairs.

item.title: Manual Milling | B&R Productions
item.description: Manual milling in New Waverly, TX. Bridgeport-style mills for prototypes, feature-add, one-off modifications, and specialty industrial parts.

item.title: Services | B&R Productions
